const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -euo pipefail
python3 -c 'import json,hashlib,pathlib,sys; m=json.load(open(".ai/task/repair-w14-20260923/PACK-MANIFEST.json")); root=pathlib.Path("evidence/quality/repair-window-14-20260923/orchestration"); bad=[]
for x in m["files"]:
 p=root/x["relative_destination"]; b=p.read_bytes() if p.is_file() else None
 if b is None or len(b)!=x["bytes"] or hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()!=x["sha256"]: bad.append(str(p))
print(json.dumps({"verified_files":len(m["files"])-len(bad),"verified_bytes":sum(x["bytes"] for x in m["files"]),"problems":bad},ensure_ascii=False)); sys.exit(bool(bad))'

for rel in evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/entries.jsonl evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/exclusions.jsonl evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/manifest.json i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite/catalog-v1.schema.json i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite/policy-v1.json; do cmp -s ".artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window14-20260923-candidate-catalog/$rel" "$rel"; done
